headline: Mexican Peso Depreciates to 18.77 per Dollar Following Banxico Guidance
summary: The Mexican peso closed at 18.77 per US dollar following monetary commentary from Banxico. Institutional analysts at Banamex forecast the exchange rate could touch 19.10 in 2027.
why: The Mexican peso is the most liquid emerging market currency in Latin America, closely aligned with trade ties to the US.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: Central bank policy expectations drove currency depreciation against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Diverging interest rate expectations between Banxico and the Fed weakened local currency positioning.
